env.ALEPHCLIENT_HOST: !if h=$(security find-generic-password -s "aleph-mcp" -a "$USER" -w 2>/dev/null); then :; else h=; fi; printf %s "${h:-$ALEPHCLIENT_HOST}"
env.ALEPHCLIENT_API_KEY: !if h=$(security find-generic-password -s "aleph-mcp" -a "$USER" -w 2>/dev/null); then :; else h=; fi; h=${h:-$ALEPHCLIENT_HOST}; if k=$(security find-generic-password -s "aleph-mcp:$h" -a "$USER" -w 2>/dev/null); then :; else k=; fi; printf %s "${k:-$ALEPHCLIENT_API_KEY}"
